input_equivalence.live: one app, one process-wide run lease, and exactly one active arm per physical run; Basalt and XRSLAM share the frozen 640x480 raw sensor contract while ARKit owns its private production-equivalent sensor chain; trajectories are not identical
input_equivalence.replay: Basalt and XRSLAM in the same app consume the exact same content-addressed EuRoC cam0+IMU manifest; ARKit replay is forbidden
input_equivalence.winner_selection: Basalt/XRSLAM accuracy uses replay; live soak compares feasibility, latency proxies, memory, thermal, battery proxy, transport loss, and tracking health; ARKit is a system reference arm and never ground truth

xrslam.artifact_platform_limit: object build versions are mixed; the highest observed iOS minimum is 26.2 despite the receipt declaring 14.0

arkit_reference.configuration: ARWorldTrackingConfiguration; autofocus=true; worldAlignment=gravity; lightEstimation=false; planeDetection=horizontal; locked 1920x1440 high-resolution-capable format; main delegate queue; resetTracking+removeExistingAnchors
arkit_reference.accuracy_role: live system reference only; no external ground truth and no EuRoC replay

unified_bench.lease_handoff: selected native handle must be destroyed and process-global engine ownership cleared before another arm may acquire the lease
unified_bench.framework_symbol_policy: only the selected C bridge API is exported; OpenCV symbols are private to each two-level dylib

apps.backend_policy: cpu for Basalt/XRSLAM; apple_arkit for ARKit reference
apps.uses_arkit_semantics: true only when an ARSession is constructed for the selected arm; framework linkage alone is not sensor use

live_soak.camera_target_hz: 30 for Basalt/XRSLAM; selected production ARVideoFormat FPS for ARKit
live_soak.camera_format: Basalt/XRSLAM mono_640x480; ARKit locked 1920x1440 high-resolution-capable production format
live_soak.camera_session_preset: AVCaptureSession.Preset.vga640x480 for Basalt/XRSLAM; ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.videoFormat for ARKit
live_soak.xrslam_official_pixel_preprocess_deviati: official iOS sample requests 32BGRA then OpenCV BGRA2GRAY; the shared Basalt/XRSLAM live contract deliberately uses the same full-range NV12 luma plane for both candidates and records this deviation

validity.loss_scope: cumulative from live sensor start across the full measurement and final drain; any loss makes the run invalid

live_soak.metric_scope: the live clock, CPU accounting, and system sampling start before selected estimator/session initialization; the complete 300-second product session is scored with no excluded warm-up, and cumulative validity also covers final drain

feasibility_gates.processed_fps_min: 27 for a 30 FPS arm; otherwise 90 percent of the frozen selected format FPS

replacement_policy.candidate_absolute_gates: every live feasibility gate and every EuRoC accuracy gate must pass
replacement_policy.same_device_dominance: candidate first usable pose delivery, p95 pipeline latency, transport loss, thermal dwell, peak footprint, CPU time, and battery proxy must be no worse than the separately run ARKit reference arm
replacement_policy.live_accuracy_claim: blocked without external ground truth; ARKit live poses are a system reference, not ground truth
replacement_policy.production_replacement_status: blocked until absolute gates, same-device dominance, external-ground-truth live accuracy, and later PocketWorld product-shadow gates all pass

replay.trajectory_frame: body_imu_frame for Basalt, XRSLAM BODY_POSE, and EuRoC p_RS_R/q_RS; camera pose is forbidden for accuracy scoring
